Norges Bank's Executive Board cut the policy rate

3 May 2026

At its meeting today, the Monetary Policy and Financial Stability Committee decided to cut the policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 3.50 per cent.

The policy rate is expected to be held broadly unchanged in the period ahead, before gradually moving down.

The Committee will continue to assess the economic outlook. The Committee stands ready to adjust the policy rate if necessary.
